en.headline: Police announce citywide no-fly zone for Interpol General Assembly next week
en.dek: From 30 November to 3 December, drones, helicopters, kites and other aerial activities will be banned across Hong Kong, with roads closed around the Wan Chai venue.
body: Police said on Monday that a temporary restricted flight zone will cover all of Hong Kong from 00:01 on 30 November until 17:00 on 3 December during the 94th Interpol General Assembly at the Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai.

Chief Superintendent Wong Chi-wing said the ban applies to small drones, helicopters, small aircraft, paragliders, airships, kites and the release of large numbers of balloons. Commercial airline flights to and from the airport will not be affected. Unauthorised activity will be illegal.

Several roads and pedestrian walkways near the venue, including areas around Golden Bauhinia Square, will be closed, and parts of Victoria Harbour will be restricted. Water taxis between Tsim Sha Tsui, Central and Wan Chai will not stop in Wan Chai. Senior Superintendent Yip Siu-ming urged motorists to avoid the area and said five bus routes would have stops relocated.
The assembly is expected to draw more than 1,000 participants, including police chiefs and senior officials from 196 member states.

zh.headline: 國際刑警全體大會下周舉行 全港設臨時禁飛區
zh.dek: 警方宣布，11月30日至12月3日期間全港禁止無人機、直升機、風箍等空中活動，灣仔會展一帶封路。
body: 警方周一表示，國際刑警組織第94屆全體大會下周一至周四在灣仔會議展覽中心舉行，期間將於全港設立臨時限制飛行區，由11月30日凌晨0時01分至12月3日下午5時生效。
行動部總警司王智榮說，禁令涵蓋小型無人機、直升機、小型飛機、滑翔傘、飛艇、風箍及放飛大量氣球。往返機場的民航航班不受影響。未經批准進行飛行活動屬違法。
會展附近多條道路及行人路，包括金紫荊廣場一帶將封閉，維港部分水域設限制。往返尖沙咀、中環及灣仔的水上的士將不停靠灣仔。高級警司葉小明呼籲駕駛人士避免前往該區，並指五條巴士路線的車站將臨時遷移。
大會預計有逾千名來自196個成員國的警隊首長及政府官員出席。
